optimizedDescription.value: Structured YAML deltas atomically modify Markdown, JSON, YAML, and plain-text AST artifacts.

optimizedContext.value:
# Delta format
## Rules
- ArtifactParser port: fileExtensions, parse, apply, serialize, renderSubtree, nodeTypes, outline, deltaInstructions, parseDelta; adapters own format behavior, domain sees port only.
- Compact default nodes: Markdown section; JSON property/array-item; YAML pair; text paragraph. Hints root type-keyed placeholders; full coverage via full detail.
- Delta YAML path: deltas/<workspace>/<capability-path>/<artifact>.delta.yaml; infer target from filename; never sync delta files. Entries: added, modified, removed, no-op.
- modified/removed require selector exact one match; resolve all selectors before mutation; failure gives DeltaApplicationError and zero partial application. after/before miss warns then append; parent miss errors.
- added uses position.parent plus exactly one optional after/before/first/last; default last/root. modified alters body and optional rename; removed deletes. Declaration order applies.
- content XOR value. modified content excludes identifier; added content includes identifier. rename only modified; reject existing or in-delta sibling collision.
- Array target strategy: replace default, append, merge-by requiring mergeKey; merge-by replaces matching objects, appends new, preserves other existing.
- no-op sole delta entry; only op/optional description. Caller skips base load, apply, delta/structural validation; hashes raw delta then markComplete.
- Reject duplicate modifying/removing same node; invalid op-field combinations; multiple placement hints; non-array strategy; mergeKey mismatch.
- deltaValidations run JSONPath rules against normalized YAML delta AST before apply.
- Markdown body edits preserve unaffected inline metadata; serializer tracks unambiguous source marker style, else deterministic project conventions.
## Constraints
- selector.index XOR selector.where.
- Any unresolved modified/removed selector hard error; after/before unresolved only warning.
- DeltaApplicationError aborts entire delta.
- YAML serialization preserves comments/formatting CST; JSON normalizes two-space indentation.
